label: WordPress
description: Publish and manage posts and pages on a WordPress site through its REST API.
notes: Auth: the piece uses CustomAuth (username, password, website_url) and sends HTTP Basic auth; mapped to WORDPRESS_USERNAME/WORDPRESS_PASSWORD via the runtime's native http.auth basic support, with the site URL as a WORDPRESS_BASE-style env credential WORDPRESS_WEBSITE_URL (must have no trailing slash — templates cannot trim). Dropped optional piece props templates cannot express: tags/categories (JSON integer arrays), featured_media (integer id), featured_media_file (separate multipart media-upload request), acfFields (free-form object), comment_status/ping_status (boolean mapped to open/closed with conditional inclusion), and date (empty string fails the REST API's date-time format validation). slug and excerpt stay optional because WordPress tolerates empty strings (slug auto-generates from title, empty excerpt is a no-op on create). status is a required select everywhere since an empty string fails enum validation. updatePost is simplified from the piece's partial update to a full overwrite — title, content, and status are required because templates cannot conditionally omit keys and empty strings would blank existing fields. Post status is lifted as postStatus on getPost to avoid clobbering the built-in HTTP status output. The piece's generic custom-API-call action was skipped (generic passthrough, not a discrete operation).
